There is no obfuscation, unexpected file manipulation, or data exfiltration.

All environment variables (`BB_DATA_DIR`, `BB_OUT_DIR`, `BB_CONFIG`) are user-controllable, allowing customization without side effects. The script operates entirely within the expected scope of a game launcher, adhering to safe packaging practices. No malicious or suspicious behavior is present.
